name: Facet
text: Ship a live contrast checker that updates in real time as users adjust the dark theme sliders. This keeps visibility high by giving immediate feedback—users see if their choices meet WCAG standards without hunting for errors. The trade-off is a slight increase in interface complexity, but the clarity and enjoyment gains outweigh it.

name: Pane
text: The live contrast checker trains users to ignore the problem after the first click—once they see green, they stop caring about accessibility. Better: make the checker a pre-submission block that forces a decision before users proceed, trading speed for compliance. Settle it with A/B testing: measure drop-off rates between the two approaches.
